22
Ahab ne Yehosafat ko tia Siriafoɔ
1Na Siria ne Israel tenaa hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a ɔko bi nni wɔn ntam. 2#2 Be 18.2-34 Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no Yudahene Yehosafat siane baa Israel hene nkyɛn. 3#Yos 21.38 Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Monnim sɛ Ramot-gilead wɔ yɛn, na yɛn deɛ yɛte hɔ komm na yɛnnye mfiri Siriahene nsam? 4#2 Ah 3.7; 2 Be 19.2 Na ɔbisaa Yehosafat sɛ: Wo ne me bɛkɔ Ramot-gilead sa anaa? Na Yehosafat buaa Israel hene no sɛ: Mete sɛ wo, me man te sɛ wo man, m’apɔnkɔ te sɛ w’apɔnkɔ.
5Na Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Bisa AWURADE asɛm nnɛ ɛ! 6Ɛnna Israel hene boaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano, wɔbɛyɛ mmarima ahanan, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Menkɔ Ramot-gilead menkɔko anaasɛ mennyae? Na wɔkaa sɛ: Foro kɔ, na AWURADE de bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa. 7#2 Ah 3.11 Ɛnna Yehosafat bisaa sɛ: AWURADE diyifoɔ biara nni ha bio a yɛbɛbisa ne hɔ adeɛ anaa? 8Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbarima baako bi da so wɔ hɔ a anka yɛbɛtumi abisa AWURADE afiri ne nkyɛn, nanso metane no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa, sɛ bɔne nko, ɛyɛ Imla ba Mikaia. Na Yehosafat se: Mma ɔhene nnka saa. 9Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ gyaaseni bi, na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma Imla ba Mikaia nnuru ha ntɛm! 10Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat tete wɔn nhennwa so hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, Samaria pono ano mpraeɛ so, na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm wɔn anim. 11Na Kenaana ba Sedekia ayɛ dadeɛ mmɛn na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Yeinom na wode bɛsum Siriafoɔ de kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie wɔn sɛeɛ. 12Na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm saa sɛ: Kɔ Ramot-gilead na kɔdi siadeɛ, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.
13Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkɔfrɛɛ Mikaia no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, adiyifoɔ no nyinaa de ano korɔ ka asɛmpa kyerɛ ɔhene, ma wo nsɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako deɛ, na ka deɛ ɛyɛ! 14Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi, deɛ AWURADE bɛka akyerɛ me no, ɛno na mɛka.
Mikaia hyɛ nkoguo ho nkɔm
15Ɛnna ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn. Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mikaia, yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko anaasɛ yɛnnyae? Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔdi nim, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa. 16Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mprɛ ahe ara na menka wo ntam sɛ, nka me asɛm bi sɛ nokorɛ nko AWURADE din mu? 17Na ɔse: Mahunu Israel nyinaa sɛ wɔahwete mmepɔ soɔ sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ, na AWURADE se: Yeinom nni wura, ma wɔnsane nkɔ wɔn afie asomdwoeɛ mu. 18#1 Ah 22.8 Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ wo sɛ ɔrenhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa biara, na mmom bɔne? 19#Adi 5.11 Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Enti tie AWURADE asɛm: Mahunu AWURADE sɛ ɔte n’adwa soɔ, na ɔsoro asafo nyinaa gyinagyina ne ho, ne nifa ne ne benkum. 20Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab na waforo akɔtɔ wɔ Ramot-gilead? Na oyi kaa sɛɛ, na oyi kaa sɛɛ. 21#Yes 19.14 Na honhom bi firi bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim kaa sɛ: Me na mɛdaadaa no. 22#Yoh 8.44; Adi 16.14 Na AWURADE bisaa no sɛ: Wode deɛn? Na ɔse: Mɛfiri makɔyɛ atorɔ honhom n’adiyifoɔ nyinaa anomu. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wobɛdaadaa no na wobɛtumi nso; firi kɔ na kɔyɛ saa. 23Na afei, hwɛ, AWURADE de honhom torofoɔ ahyɛ w’adiyifoɔ yi nyinaa anomu, na AWURADE aka wo ho bɔne.
24Ɛnna Kenaana ba Sedekia twe pini bɛbɔɔ Mikaia sotorɔ kaa sɛ: Ɛhe na AWURADE honhom nam firii me nkyɛn kɔ kasa kyerɛɛ woɔ yi? 25Na Mikaia se: Hwɛ, da a wobɛfiri pia mu akɔ pia mu akɔhunta no na wobɛhunu. 26Ɛnna Israel hene kaa sɛ: Kyere Mikaia, na fa no kɔ kuro no so hwɛfoɔ Amon ne ɔhene ba Yoas nkyɛn, 27na kɔka sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Momfa oyi nto nneduadan mu, na momma no ahohiahia aduane nni ne ahohiahia nsuo nnom kɔsi sɛ mɛba no dwoodwoo. 28Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ wosane ba dwoodwoo a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔnam me so kasaeɛ. Na ɔse: Mo aman nyinaa, montie!
Ahab wuo
(2 Berɛsosɛm 18.28-34)
29Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat foro kɔɔ Ramot-gilead. 30Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Mɛsakyera me ho na makɔ ɔko no ano, na wo deɛ, hyɛ wo ntadeɛ. Na Israel hene no sakyeraa ne ho, na ɔkɔɔ ko no ano. 31Nso na Siriahene no ahyɛ ne nteaseɛnam a ɔwɔ no so asafohene aduasa mmienu no sɛ: Ma monne akumaa anaa ɔkɛseɛ nnko, gye Israel hene no nko. 32Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu Yehosafat no, wɔkaa sɛ: Ampa, Israel hene no nie! Na wɔmane ne no kɔkoe. Na Yehosafat teaa mu. 33Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene ne no no, wɔsane firii n’akyi. 34#2 Be 35.23 Na ɔbarima bi twee ne tadua mu anibiannasoɔ so, na ɔde saa Israel hene no mmɔtoam ne nkataboɔ no ntam. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnamkafoɔ no sɛ: Dane wo ho fa me firi ɛdɔm yi mu, na mapira. 35Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ den da no. Na wɔkura ɔhene no mu maa no gyinaa teaseɛnam no mu Siriafoɔ no anim ara, na ɔwuu anwummerɛ. Na apirakuro no mu mogya sene guu teaseɛnam no mu. 36Na wɔpae faa nsraban no mu owiatɔ berɛ sɛ: Obiara nkɔ ne kurom ne n’asase so.
37Na ɔhene no wui, na wɔde no baa Samaria; na wɔsiee ɔhene no Samaria. 38#1 Ah 21.19; 2 Ah 9.25 Na wɔkɔhohoroo teaseɛnam no mu wɔ Samaria tareɛ mu, na akraman bɛtaferee ne mogya, na mmaa nnwamamfoɔ nso dwaree mu, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no teɛ no. 39Na Ahab ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne asonse dan a ɔsiiɛ, ne nkuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa? 40#1 Ah 22.51 Na Ahab toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Ahasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yehosafat di Yuda so hene
(2 Berɛsosɛm 20.31—21.1)
41 # 2 Be 20.31—21.1 Na Israelhene Ahab afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu na Asa ba Yehosafat bɛdii Yuda so hene. 42Yehosafat bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Asuba a ɔyɛ Silhi ba. 43#1 Ah 15.14; 2 Ah 12.3 Na ɔfaa n’agya Asa kwan nyinaa so, wammane amfiri ho, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so; gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no na wɔanyiyie, ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ. 44Na asomdwoeɛ bɛdaa Yehosafat ne Israel hene ntam.
45 # 2 Be 17.1-19 Na Yehosafat ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔdii ako no, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa? 46#1 Ah 15.12 Na mmarima nnwamamfoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔgyaa wɔn n’agya Asa nna mu no, ɔhyee wɔn ase firii asase no so.
47Na ɔhene bi nni Edom; na ɔhene abadiakyire na na ɔhwɛ akyire sɛ ɔhene; 48#1 Ah 9.28 Yehosafat yɛɛ Tarsis ahyɛn sɛ ɛnkɔ Ofir na ɛnkɔpɛ sika kɔkɔɔ, nanso ankɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ahyɛn no bobɔe wɔ Esion-geber. 49Ɛno mu na Ahab ba Ahasia ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ma me nkoa ne wo nkoa nkɔ ahyɛn no mu. Na Yehosafat ampene. 50#2 Ah 8.16 Na Yehosafat toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, n’agya Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Yehoram bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahasia di Israel so hene
51 # 1 Ah 22.40 Ahab ba Ahasia bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria, Yudahene Yehosafat afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu, na ɔdii Israel so mfeɛ mmienu. 52#1 Ah 12.30 Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔfaa n’agya kwan so, ne ne na kwan so, ne Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no kwan so; 53#1 Ah 16.31-33 na ɔsomm Baal na ɔsɔree no, na ɔhuruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn bo, sɛdeɛ n’agya yɛeɛ no ara.

Na Siria ne Israel tenaa hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a ɔko bi nni wɔn ntam. Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no Yudahene Yehosafat siane baa Israel hene nkyɛn. Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Monnim sɛ Ramot-gilead wɔ yɛn, na yɛn deɛ yɛte hɔ komm na yɛnnye mfiri Siriahene nsam? Na ɔbisaa Yehosafat sɛ: Wo ne me bɛkɔ Ramot-gilead sa anaa? Na Yehosafat buaa Israel hene no sɛ: Mete sɛ wo, me man te sɛ wo man, m’apɔnkɔ te sɛ w’apɔnkɔ.
Na Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Bisa AWURADE asɛm nnɛ ɛ! Ɛnna Israel hene boaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano, wɔbɛyɛ mmarima ahanan, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Menkɔ Ramot-gilead menkɔko anaasɛ mennyae? Na wɔkaa sɛ: Foro kɔ, na AWURADE de bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa. Ɛnna Yehosafat bisaa sɛ: AWURADE diyifoɔ biara nni ha bio a yɛbɛbisa ne hɔ adeɛ anaa? Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbarima baako bi da so wɔ hɔ a anka yɛbɛtumi abisa AWURADE afiri ne nkyɛn, nanso metane no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa, sɛ bɔne nko, ɛyɛ Imla ba Mikaia. Na Yehosafat se: Mma ɔhene nnka saa. Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ gyaaseni bi, na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma Imla ba Mikaia nnuru ha ntɛm! Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat tete wɔn nhennwa so hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, Samaria pono ano mpraeɛ so, na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm wɔn anim. Na Kenaana ba Sedekia ayɛ dadeɛ mmɛn na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Yeinom na wode bɛsum Siriafoɔ de kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie wɔn sɛeɛ. Na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm saa sɛ: Kɔ Ramot-gilead na kɔdi siadeɛ, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkɔfrɛɛ Mikaia no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, adiyifoɔ no nyinaa de ano korɔ ka asɛmpa kyerɛ ɔhene, ma wo nsɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako deɛ, na ka deɛ ɛyɛ! Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi, deɛ AWURADE bɛka akyerɛ me no, ɛno na mɛka.

Ɛnna ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn. Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mikaia, yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko anaasɛ yɛnnyae? Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔdi nim, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa. Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mprɛ ahe ara na menka wo ntam sɛ, nka me asɛm bi sɛ nokorɛ nko AWURADE din mu? Na ɔse: Mahunu Israel nyinaa sɛ wɔahwete mmepɔ soɔ sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ, na AWURADE se: Yeinom nni wura, ma wɔnsane nkɔ wɔn afie asomdwoeɛ mu. Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ wo sɛ ɔrenhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa biara, na mmom bɔne? Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Enti tie AWURADE asɛm: Mahunu AWURADE sɛ ɔte n’adwa soɔ, na ɔsoro asafo nyinaa gyinagyina ne ho, ne nifa ne ne benkum. Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab na waforo akɔtɔ wɔ Ramot-gilead? Na oyi kaa sɛɛ, na oyi kaa sɛɛ. Na honhom bi firi bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim kaa sɛ: Me na mɛdaadaa no. Na AWURADE bisaa no sɛ: Wode deɛn? Na ɔse: Mɛfiri makɔyɛ atorɔ honhom n’adiyifoɔ nyinaa anomu. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wobɛdaadaa no na wobɛtumi nso; firi kɔ na kɔyɛ saa. Na afei, hwɛ, AWURADE de honhom torofoɔ ahyɛ w’adiyifoɔ yi nyinaa anomu, na AWURADE aka wo ho bɔne.
Ɛnna Kenaana ba Sedekia twe pini bɛbɔɔ Mikaia sotorɔ kaa sɛ: Ɛhe na AWURADE honhom nam firii me nkyɛn kɔ kasa kyerɛɛ woɔ yi? Na Mikaia se: Hwɛ, da a wobɛfiri pia mu akɔ pia mu akɔhunta no na wobɛhunu. Ɛnna Israel hene kaa sɛ: Kyere Mikaia, na fa no kɔ kuro no so hwɛfoɔ Amon ne ɔhene ba Yoas nkyɛn, na kɔka sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Momfa oyi nto nneduadan mu, na momma no ahohiahia aduane nni ne ahohiahia nsuo nnom kɔsi sɛ mɛba no dwoodwoo. Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ wosane ba dwoodwoo a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔnam me so kasaeɛ. Na ɔse: Mo aman nyinaa, montie!


Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat foro kɔɔ Ramot-gilead. Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Mɛsakyera me ho na makɔ ɔko no ano, na wo deɛ, hyɛ wo ntadeɛ. Na Israel hene no sakyeraa ne ho, na ɔkɔɔ ko no ano. Nso na Siriahene no ahyɛ ne nteaseɛnam a ɔwɔ no so asafohene aduasa mmienu no sɛ: Ma monne akumaa anaa ɔkɛseɛ nnko, gye Israel hene no nko. Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu Yehosafat no, wɔkaa sɛ: Ampa, Israel hene no nie! Na wɔmane ne no kɔkoe. Na Yehosafat teaa mu. Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene ne no no, wɔsane firii n’akyi. Na ɔbarima bi twee ne tadua mu anibiannasoɔ so, na ɔde saa Israel hene no mmɔtoam ne nkataboɔ no ntam. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnamkafoɔ no sɛ: Dane wo ho fa me firi ɛdɔm yi mu, na mapira. Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ den da no. Na wɔkura ɔhene no mu maa no gyinaa teaseɛnam no mu Siriafoɔ no anim ara, na ɔwuu anwummerɛ. Na apirakuro no mu mogya sene guu teaseɛnam no mu. Na wɔpae faa nsraban no mu owiatɔ berɛ sɛ: Obiara nkɔ ne kurom ne n’asase so.
Na ɔhene no wui, na wɔde no baa Samaria; na wɔsiee ɔhene no Samaria. Na wɔkɔhohoroo teaseɛnam no mu wɔ Samaria tareɛ mu, na akraman bɛtaferee ne mogya, na mmaa nnwamamfoɔ nso dwaree mu, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no teɛ no. Na Ahab ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne asonse dan a ɔsiiɛ, ne nkuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa? Na Ahab toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Ahasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.


Na Israelhene Ahab afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu na Asa ba Yehosafat bɛdii Yuda so hene. Yehosafat bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Asuba a ɔyɛ Silhi ba. Na ɔfaa n’agya Asa kwan nyinaa so, wammane amfiri ho, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so; gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no na wɔanyiyie, ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ. Na asomdwoeɛ bɛdaa Yehosafat ne Israel hene ntam.
Na Yehosafat ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔdii ako no, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa? Na mmarima nnwamamfoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔgyaa wɔn n’agya Asa nna mu no, ɔhyee wɔn ase firii asase no so.
Na ɔhene bi nni Edom; na ɔhene abadiakyire na na ɔhwɛ akyire sɛ ɔhene; Yehosafat yɛɛ Tarsis ahyɛn sɛ ɛnkɔ Ofir na ɛnkɔpɛ sika kɔkɔɔ, nanso ankɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ahyɛn no bobɔe wɔ Esion-geber. Ɛno mu na Ahab ba Ahasia ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ma me nkoa ne wo nkoa nkɔ ahyɛn no mu. Na Yehosafat ampene. Na Yehosafat toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, n’agya Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Yehoram bɛdii n’adeɛ.

Ahab ba Ahasia bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria, Yudahene Yehosafat afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu, na ɔdii Israel so mfeɛ mmienu. Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔfaa n’agya kwan so, ne ne na kwan so, ne Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no kwan so; na ɔsomm Baal na ɔsɔree no, na ɔhuruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn bo, sɛdeɛ n’agya yɛeɛ no ara.

app.take_word: Take God’s Word with you wherever you go by downloading the free Bible App. Listen to audio Bibles, create Prayers, study with Friends, and much more—all for free. Choose from more than 2,400 Bible versions in over 1,600 languages on your computer, phone, or tablet.
app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
